name: Epilogue
source:
Welcome aboard the Esperanza. Thirty years ago, this spaceship arrived at the alien planet Ceti-Six – and was never heard from again.

Explore the ship and discover what happened to its crew.

[From [url=https://mutive.itch.io/epilogue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎登上埃斯佩兰萨号。三十年前，这艘宇宙飞船抵达外星球Ceti-Six，从此杳无音讯。

探索这艘船并了解其船员的遭遇。

[来自[url=https://mutive.itch.io/epilogue]Itch.io[/url]]
